jobs.title: Change Manager
jobs.summary: This role ensures that all production changes across Remote Slots and Live Casino are centrally tracked, communicated, and aligned with regulatory and licensing requirements. The Change Manager coordinates stakeholders, maintains the change register, and prepares release documentation to reduce risk and support regulatory audits.
jobs.details: O poslodavcu About the Role Stakelogic is searching for a dedicated Change Manager function to bring structured coordination to how changes reach production across both our Remote Slots and Live Casino product lines. This is a newly created, company-wide role sitting between Delivery Management, Development, QA, IT, legal, Technical Account Management team and Regulatory and Technical Compliance. The Change Manager does not implement changes directly — the role exists to make sure every change to production is properly tracked, communicated, and handled in line with Stakelogic's Change Management Policy and applicable regulatory and license requirements. Key Responsibilities Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following: Own end-to-end tracking of all front-end and back-end releases to production, across both Remote Slots and Live Casino. Maintain an accurate, up-to-date change/version register — current production version, staging/dev versions, per game and per environment. Prepare and distribute release notes for production updates, coordinating timing and content with Development, QA, and Operations. Act as the central coordination point between Delivery Management, Development, QA, Operations, IT, legal, Regulatory and Technical Compliance for change-related activity, without being the person implementing the technical change. Liaise with IT to capture and log infrastructure, server, and hardware changes, and help route anything with regulatory reporting implications to Compliance. Support periodic regulatory audit calls (e.g. quarterly submissions for jurisdictions including, but not limited to, Denmark, UK, Greece, and Malta), compiling supporting materials together with Delivery Managers. Stay aware of jurisdiction-specific technical/regulatory expectations relevant to change activity (e.g. including but not limited to regulatory authorities such as the HGC, UKGC, MGA) and flag compliance implications early to the relevant teams. Operate within Stakelogic's current Change Management Policy, and flag gaps or practical issues encountered — including areas not yet reflected in the policy, such as Live Casino coverage — to the ISMS Manager responsible for maintaining that policy. Provide backup support on delivery coordination tasks, given the natural overlap between this role and Delivery Management. Experience in iGaming, gambling, or another tightly regulated technology sector is strongly preferred — familiarity with regulator interactions (e.g. regulatory authorities such as but not limited to the HGC, UKGC, MGA) is a real advantage. Comfortable owning detailed tracking and documentation (spreadsheets, Jira, or similar tools) with high attention to accuracy. Strong cross-functional communicator, able to coordinate Development, QA, Operations, IT, legal, Regulatory and Technical Compliance stakeholders. Working understanding of software release lifecycles (dev/staging/production environments, versioning) — deep engineering background is not required, but technical literacy is. jobs.details: O poslodavcu TESLA PANELS d.o.o. kompanija koja se bavi proizvodnjom visokokvalitetnih sendvič panela i predstavlja jednog od lidera u oblasti savremene industrijske gradnje, zbog proširenja obima poslovanja i daljeg razvoja proizvodnih kapaciteta raspisuje konkurs za poziciju: IT ADMINISTRATOR Mesto rada: Beograd – Šimanovci Kao ERP/MES/WMS Administrator bićete odgovorni za stabilan, efikasan i kontinuiran rad informacionih sistema koji podržavaju proizvodnju i poslovne procese kompanije. Vaše ključne odgovornosti su: administracija, održavanje i unapređenje ERP, MES i WMS sistema; pružanje podrške korisnicima iz proizvodnje, finansija i logistike; praćenje rada sistema, identifikovanje i rešavanje problema i sistemskih zastoja; unapređenje aplikativnih rešenja u skladu sa potrebama proizvodnje i poslovanja; praćenje realizacije zahteva korisnika i obezbeđivanje kvalitetne i pravovremene IT podrške; praćenje zaduživanja i rasknjižavanja radnih naloga u saradnji sa proizvodnjom; dizajniranje izveštaja i razvoj korisničkih funkcionalnosti; konfigurisanje ERP/MES/WMS aplikacija, kao i pisanje prilagođenih programa i skripti; saradnja sa eksternim dobavljačima ERP/MES/WMS rešenja; priprema i implementacija ažuriranja i novih verzija sistema; testiranje, dijagnostika i optimizacija performansi sistema; obuka krajnjih korisnika i izrada dokumentacije za ERP/MES/WMS procese. Reference: cbx9gFBQ5JllrlaUV0VwG7lnkactpgXut6dq1guFsEmBO-G5DsI6TX4t91Em0mah Potrebne kvalifikacije i specifična znanja: minimum VI stepen stručne spreme, informatičkog smera; minimum 1 godinu iskustva na sličnim poslovima; iskustvo u radu sa ERP, MES ili WMS sistemima; iskustvo u upravljanju projektima; dobro poznavanje engleskog jezika; osnovno poznavanje finansijskih parametara i izveštaja; izražene analitičke i organizacione sposobnosti; vozačku dozvolu B kategorije i aktivno vozačko iskustvo. Šta nudimo: Rad u stabilnoj i brzo rastućoj proizvodnoj kompaniji. Direktni uticaj na unapređenje proizvodnih i poslovnih procesa i priliku za razvoj i unapređenje informacionih rešenja u realnom poslovnom okruženju; saradnju sa različitim poslovnim funkcijama – proizvodnjom, logistikom, finansijama i menadžmentom; Stimulativna i redovna primanja. Napomena: Biće kontaktirani samo kandidati koji uđu u uži krug selekcije. Zahvaljujemo svim kandidatima na interesovanju za zaposlenje u kompaniji TESLA PANELS d.o.o. TESLA PANELS DOO TESLA PANELS d.o.o., kompanija koja se bavi proizvodnjom visokokvalitetnih sendvič panela i predstavlja jednog od lidera u oblasti savremene industrijske gradnje na Srpskom tržištu koji se takođe uspešno pozicionirao i na inostranim tržištima. Klijentima pružamo vrhunsku uslugu, visoko kvalitetne proizvode, podršku u prodaji i razvoju, prateći i vodeći računa o njihovim očekivanjima. Reagujemo proaktivno, inovativno i fleksibilno. jobs.title: KICKSTART - Test and Quality Assurance Junior Specialist - Intern
jobs.summary: This internship exists to ensure high quality of TV and streaming applications by executing manual tests and validating core media features on real devices. The role supports release readiness through defect documentation verification and collaboration with developers and product stakeholders.
jobs.details: O poslodavcu As a Test & QA Junior Specialist intern, you will join the team responsible for the quality of our TV applications used daily on Smart TVs, set-top boxes and streaming devices. You will gain hands-on experience in testing live TV, video on demand and interactive features, working alongside experienced QA engineers on real devices in a dedicated test lab. What we will expect from you: Prepare, maintain and execute manual test cases based on business requirements, acceptance criteria and user stories Test TV applications on different platforms and devices (Android TV / Google TV, Samsung Tizen, LG webOS, Apple tvOS, set-top boxes) Validate core TV features such as live TV, EPG (TV guide), catch-up, recordings, VOD, search, profiles and parental control Verify video playback quality, including startup time, buffering, stream switching, audio tracks, subtitles and resolution/HDR support Test remote control navigation, focus behavior and overall user experience on large screens Perform regression, smoke and exploratory testing before each release Test application behavior under different network conditions (slow connection, connection loss, Wi-Fi vs Ethernet) Document defects with clear reproduction steps, device details, logs, screenshots and video recordings Monitor the defect lifecycle and verify implemented fixes Validate backend services and APIs that support the TV applications Create and maintain test documentation, including test cases, test reports and release summaries Collaborate with developers, Product Owners,
